correctness.rationale: The input [1] proves all nonfree points (1080) have cyclic order-3 stabilizers. Orbit–stabilizer gives 40, symplectic linearization gives exactly 1/3(1,1,2,2), and Reid–Tai gives terminality. [2] gives b(X)=(1,0,7,8,108,8,7,0,1), translation-invariant H³ and the 28-dimensional Sym²H² sector; canonical local-system transport and Lefschetz yield tr(g,H⁴)=27 for every g≠1, hence b4(Y)=28. Transfer for finite quotients gives cohomology, Hodge decomposition matches Sym²H², and Batyrev global quotient formula adds 80 (uv)² terms because each g≠1 fixes one orbit of 27 points of age 2. Armstrong and Verbitsky establish fundamental group and lack of crepant resolution. CHECK.py independently verifies all abstract F₃⁴ incidence and integer arithmetic but not the external geometric input; exact universal proof is in RESULT.md.

originality.rationale: The primary November 12 construction determines its 1080 nonfree points but not the quotient singularity basket, rational Hodge diamond or stringy polynomial; the 2018 cohomology paper supplies the covering-space cohomology and the 2025 terminalization paper offers broader invariant-cohomology methods for other quotient settings. The complete 40-point terminal quotient computation and stringy Hodge equality without a crepant model were not identified in these full texts or mathematical-record searches. The result is a nontrivial combination of previously known input theorems, not an independently new cohomology theory; earlier unindexed specialization remains an acknowledged risk.
residual_risks: The full quotient may have been worked out in an unindexed earlier symplectic orbifold study not uncovered by title, parameter and conceptual searches.
Some individual outputs are short consequences of cited fixed-locus and cohomology theorems; scientific value concerns the complete natural Hodge and stringy quotient classification.
Independent expert validation of deformation-equivariant H³ and the stringy Hodge comparison has not occurred.

value.rationale: The 2026 explicit Kummer fourfold family comes with a natural full level-three action whose quotient geometry had not been made explicit in the checked sources. A complete intrinsic classification of its 40 isolated terminal germs, cohomology, regular-locus fundamental group and Hodge/stringy numbers is a motivated exact invariant package. The equality E_st(Y)=E(X) in a case admitting no crepant resolution is a geometrically informative contrast, even though individual ingredients are classical and no general quotient theorem is claimed.
